items.title: 10.10.1 Finding the charge on 1 mole of electrons (1 mole electrons ka charge maloom karna) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.10.1 with Figure 10.2, printed page 223.

blocks.text: 1 mole electrons ka charge ek saade electrolysis ke experiment (tajurba) se maloom kiya ja sakta hai. Is ka apparatus (saaman) Figure 10.2 mein dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.alt: Copper(II) sulfate ki electrolysis ka circuit. Battery (left side +) ammeter ke zariye left copper anode se juri hai (taar par teer anode ki taraf), aur variable resistor ke zariye right copper cathode se. Dono copper electrodes beaker mein CuSO4 (aq) solution mein doobe hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.2: Jama hone wale copper ki mass ka hisab lagane ka apparatus (kitab ki Figure 10.2 jaisa original diagram).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Battery, ammeter aur variable resistor ek series circuit mein hain. Ammeter current napta hai aur variable resistor current ko constant (na badalne wala) rakhta hai. Dono electrodes pure (khalis) copper ke hain aur CuSO₄ solution mein doobe hain.

Tareeqa: pure copper anode aur pure copper cathode ko alag alag weigh karein (tolen) aur aqueous copper(II) sulfate ki electrolysis ke liye apparatus Figure 10.2 ki tarah lagayen. Variable resistor se current taqreeban 0.2 ampere par constant rakhein. Constant current ek napi hui time period (muddat), maslan 40 min, tak guzarein. Phir cathode aur anode nikal kar distilled water aur phir propanone se dho kar sukhayen, aur dobara tolen.

Cathode ki mass barhti hai kyun ke us par copper jamta hai. Anode ki mass kam hoti hai kyun ke us ka copper ions ban kar solution mein chala jata hai. Anode ki mass mein kami napi jati hai, kyun ke copper hamesha cathode se achhi tarah chipakta nahi (kuch jhar sakta hai).

blocks.prompt: Electrodes ko aakhir mein propanone se kyun dhoya jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Propanone pani ko hata deta hai aur jaldi evaporate (ur) ho jata hai, is liye electrode garam kiye baghair jaldi sookh jata hai aur tolne mein pani ka wazan shamil nahi hota.

items: Copper electrodes tolein; CuSO₄(aq) mein ~0.2 A constant current napi time period tak guzarein.
Pani aur propanone se dho kar sukhayen aur dobara tolen; anode ki mass ki kami istemal karein.
